_notice: Simplified teaching subset of MITRE ATT&CK (enterprise). Always confirm IDs and names at https://attack.mitre.org before quoting them in a real report.

brute_force.name: Brute Force
brute_force.description: Repeated password guessing against one or more accounts.
brute_force.why: Many failed logins from one source in a short time is the textbook fingerprint.

password_guessing.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
password_guessing.description: Guessing passwords for a known account.
password_guessing.why: Repeated failures against the same username.

password_spray.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
password_spray.description: Trying a few common passwords across many accounts.
password_spray.why: One source touching many different usernames with only a few tries each.

credential_stuffing.name: Brute Force: Credential Stuffing
credential_stuffing.description: Replaying username/password pairs leaked from other breaches.
credential_stuffing.why: One account failing from many different IPs.

valid_account_login.name: Valid Accounts
valid_account_login.description: Using legitimate credentials to log in.
valid_account_login.why: A successful login after failures, or from an unusual place, suggests stolen credentials.

impossible_travel.name: Valid Accounts
impossible_travel.description: Using legitimate credentials to log in.
impossible_travel.why: Two distant logins too close in time usually means the credentials are in two different hands.

ssh_remote_login.name: Remote Services: SSH
ssh_remote_login.description: Logging in to systems over SSH.
ssh_remote_login.why: Interactive SSH sessions from unexpected sources.

phishing_email.name: Phishing
phishing_email.description: Sending deceptive messages to gain access.
phishing_email.why: Failed authentication, spoofed sender and urgency in an email.

phishing_link.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
phishing_link.description: Emails that lead the victim to a malicious link.
phishing_link.why: Link text that does not match the real destination.

malicious_file_execution.name: User Execution: Malicious File
malicious_file_execution.description: Tricking a user into opening a malicious file.
malicious_file_execution.why: The attacker relies on the victim running an attachment or download.

lookalike_domain.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Domains
lookalike_domain.description: Registering domains to support an attack.
lookalike_domain.why: Look-alike domains such as paypa1.com are registered for phishing.

email_impersonation.name: Impersonation
email_impersonation.description: Pretending to be a trusted person or brand.
email_impersonation.why: Display-name spoofing and Reply-To mismatches (for example CEO fraud).

port_scan.name: Network Service Discovery
port_scan.description: Probing hosts to find listening services.
port_scan.why: One source touching many ports and getting denied.

web_exploit.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
web_exploit.description: Exploiting a flaw in an internet-facing application.
web_exploit.why: Unusual requests to a web application that lead to code execution.

webshell.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
webshell.description: A script on a web server that gives remote command execution.

command_execution.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
command_execution.description: Running commands or scripts on a system.
command_execution.why: Shell commands launched by a newly compromised account.

tool_download.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
tool_download.description: Bringing attacker tools onto a compromised host.
tool_download.why: curl or wget downloading a script from an unknown server.

c2_beaconing.name: Application Layer Protocol
c2_beaconing.description: Using normal protocols to talk to attacker infrastructure.
c2_beaconing.why: Regular, repeated outbound connections to the same external IP and port.

data_exfiltration.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
data_exfiltration.description: Stealing data over the existing command-and-control channel.
data_exfiltration.why: Large outbound transfers to a known-bad destination.

account_creation.name: Create Account
account_creation.description: Creating a new account to keep access.
account_creation.why: useradd or similar run by a compromised account.

sudo_abuse.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
sudo_abuse.description: Abusing sudo to run commands as root.
sudo_abuse.why: A freshly compromised user running privileged commands.

log_clearing.name: Indicator Removal
log_clearing.why: Logs truncated or deleted after suspicious activity.

scheduled_task.name: Scheduled Task/Job
scheduled_task.description: Using cron or scheduled tasks to run code.
scheduled_task.why: New cron entries created outside change windows.
